title: Brake Appointment Standards by Line: Bay Time, Horizon, Lead Time and Moves
content:
Bay time and booking limits for brake appointments under Brake Service Warranties are set per line:

| Brake service line | Bay time reserved, minutes | Booking horizon, calendar days | Minimum lead time, hours | Moves allowed per appointment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 90 | 30 | 2 | 2 |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 90 | 30 | 2 | 2 |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 90 | 30 | 2 | 2 |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 90 | 30 | 2 | 2 |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 120 | 30 | 2 | 2 |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 120 | 30 | 4 | 2 |

**Definitions.**
- *Bay time reserved* — the bay time held for one brake appointment.
- *Booking horizon* — how far ahead a brake visit can be booked, in calendar days.
- *Minimum lead time* — the fewest hours between the booking and the appointment start.
- *Moves allowed per appointment* — the number of times one brake appointment may be moved.

**Differences between lines.** The Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty and the Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty reserve 120 minutes of bay time; the other four lines reserve 90. The Severe-Duty line requires a 4-hour minimum lead time; every other line requires 2 hours. The 30-day horizon and the 2 moves per appointment are the same on all six lines.
